title: Counting below a successor threshold
statement: Let $kf:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and $t,j\in\mathbb{N}$. The number of indices $i<j$ with $kf(i)<t+1$ equals the number with $kf(i)<t$ plus the number with $kf(i)=t$.
